races.paceDynamic: Mullacash Buzz is the sole confirmed front-runner and will get an uncontested lead, setting a comfortable gallop with minimal early pressure. Brains, Manhattan Dandy, Serengeti Sunrise, My Kurkum and Areyousure may sit prominent but lack the pace to challenge early. The mid-race tempo will be moderate with most of the field held up including Jasmine Affanalis, Kitty Bear, Cordouan, Maw Can, and Profit Surge. This sustainable pace followed by a sprint finish strongly favours hold-up horses with a turn of foot who can close late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mullacash Buzz maintains his recent improved form with blinkers fitted
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets perfect fractions and proves hard to peg back up the straight with most closers giving him too much rope. His regular success around Roscommon and fair Dundalk fourth suggests he can exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly sedate and suits strong finishers
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows closers to unleash devastating late kicks with Jasmine Affanalis and Kitty Bear having the class edge. Both have shown winning form at this level and benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can get first run on the leader
scenarios.body: Brains or Manhattan Dandy position themselves perfectly behind Mullacash Buzz and strike with 2f to run. Both have course form and the tactical nous to exploit their positions just behind the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Mullacash Buzz goes too slow and multiple horses charge late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse with a bit of zip can win from anywhere. The form book goes out the window in a blanket finish with outsiders getting competitive.

races.paceDynamic: Fast Tara will lead from the wide draw with no other confirmed front-runners in this field. The presence of several prominent runners like Sun Soldier, Chester Nimitz, and Neo Smart will create a moderate early gallop but Fast Tara shouldn't face severe pressure. With 18 runners including many hold-up horses like San Aer, Anvika, and Earls, the pace will be sustainable early before quickening in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses that can sit handy and kick, as the lone leader may tire and the hold-up brigade will struggle to make up ground from the back in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Handy Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners position well and Fast Tara sets manageable fractions
scenarios.body: The race develops perfectly for horses sitting 3rd-6th who can quicken when Fast Tara comes back to them in the final furlong. These runners avoid traffic issues that will plague the back markers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Fast Tara Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Fast Tara gets easy lead fractions and the field fails to mount serious challenge
scenarios.body: The leader maintains her advantage to the line as the prominent runners fail to close decisively and the hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do. Her course-and-distance experience proves crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly strong with prominent runners pressuring Fast Tara early
scenarios.body: The early pace collapses allowing a patient hold-up horse with tactical speed to sweep through late. The field spreads out creating racing room for the closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes messy with trouble in running for the fancied runners
scenarios.body: Traffic problems and interference allow a well-positioned outsider to steal through for victory. The large field creates chaos that favours horses drawn well with alert jockeys.

races.paceDynamic: Girl Bear is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should dictate a sustainable pace without serious early pressure. Prominent runners like Gold Inn, Coincidental Glory, and Merry Blacksmith may track close but lack the early zip to challenge Girl Bear's lead. The majority of this field are hold-up horses including Personified, Thirsty Owl, Zermatt Star, and Wicklow Gap, creating a natural tactical scenario where the pace will be reasonable early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit handy and kick, as they'll avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will befall the large contingent of hold-up horses in the final furlong scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Girl Bear sets uncontested fractions and prominent trackers position ideally
scenarios.body: The handy horses avoid the late traffic and can quicken clear while hold-up horses struggle for racing room in a bunched finish. Coincidental Glory and Gold Inn get first run on the field while others are still seeking gaps.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and hold-up horses get clean runs
scenarios.body: Personified's class tells late as she weaves through to win, with other patient riders finding room to finish strongly. The early leaders capitulate under pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pacemaker Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Girl Bear's uncontested lead proves insurmountable despite her recent poor form
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets such an easy time of it early that she has enough left to hold off late challengers. Her superior tactical position trumps recent disappointing efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improver Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Zermatt Star or Thirsty Owl shows significant improvement from their breaks
scenarios.body: Either the Harrington newcomer or McLoughlin's returning charge produces a career-best effort to land a surprise. Fresh legs and new surroundings spark improvement.

races.paceDynamic: He's Holding Court is the sole confirmed front runner and will likely get an uncontested lead in this 13-runner handicap. With Substance and Lumiere Des Etoile the only prominent racers, the early pace should be steady rather than fierce. The majority of the field - including One Cool Bear, Sunrise Angel, Love Orchid, and Running Point - are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop. This race shape strongly favours horses that can travel kindly in midfield and finish, as the modest early gallop will create a bunched finish where stamina and a strong kick matter most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Kick
scenarios.trigger: If He's Holding Court gets an easy lead and the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get ideal conditions as the field stays bunched, allowing the best finishers to unleash late runs. One Cool Bear and Sunrise Angel, both showing consistent form, can capitalize on their preferred patient tactics.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Fade Late
scenarios.trigger: If He's Holding Court and the prominent racers set slightly stronger fractions than expected
scenarios.body: The early pace takes more out of the leaders, creating opportunities for horses tracking closer. Substance and Lumiere Des Etoile benefit from being handy without leading, while some hold-up horses arrive too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade all come with runs simultaneously in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Too many horses with similar tactics create traffic problems and a scrappy finish. The horse with the clearest run or best position prevails, likely favoring those drawn better or with stronger jockeys.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If He's Holding Court gets such an easy time in front that he can sustain his kick
scenarios.body: The lightweight leader uses his 19lb advantage and uncontested lead to maximum effect. His recent form suggests he fades, but the tactical advantage could prove decisive on this occasion.

watchPoints.text: He's Holding Court could get such an easy lead that his weight allowance compensates for his tendency to fade

races.paceDynamic: Rebel Ascendant will be the only confirmed early leader in this small field, setting sustainable fractions without pressure from the prominent division. Sir Benji, Dial Me In, Nil Bua Gan Dua and Marjorie Daw are all hold-up types who will settle off the pace, creating a tactical logjam behind the leader. With minimal early pace and most runners wanting to come from behind, this sets up perfectly for the pace-setter to dictate terms. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Rebel Ascendant Wire Job

scenarios.body: The debut winner can dictate comfortable splits and prove hard to peg back when the hold-up horses finally get organized. With so many closers bunched together, they'll struggle for racing room and clear runs when it matters.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.body: O'Brien's runner has faced much stronger opposition and could find this easier assignment to his liking. His high-class breeding and previous form at this level gives him a fitness edge over the less exposed types.

scenarios.body: The Joseph O'Brien runner was one-paced last time but the headgear change could unlock more. His trainer's excellent 14-day record provides confidence that both stable runners come here in peak condition.

races.paceDynamic: Radar Ahead will set a steady, uncontested lead with minimal early pressure from this large field of mostly hold-up horses and midfield runners. Daboya, Churchwarden and Robot Rock may track in second/third positions but none are aggressive pace pressers, allowing Radar Ahead to dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The genuine pace will only emerge from the 3f pole as the hold-up brigade including Stepdance, Kakori and Doctor Grace attempt to mount their challenges from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions without pressure, as the majority of the field will be relying on finishing kicks from unpromising positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Radar Ahead gets soft fractions and stays galloping
scenarios.body: With no pace pressure early, Radar Ahead can time his effort perfectly and prove too strong for late closers over this stamina-sapping trip. The combination of good recent form at Navan and ideal tactical position makes him very hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and bunches the field
scenarios.body: A slow early tempo allows the better handicapped hold-up horses to get closer than usual and unleash decisive finishing kicks. Stepdance's hat-trick form over similar trips on good ground makes him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Daboya or Churchwarden can improve positions mid-race
scenarios.body: The prominent runners use Radar Ahead's honest pace to get into perfect striking positions turning for home, then outstay the leader in the final furlong. Fresh legs from the long break could prove decisive for either.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unconsidered Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure lottery where any horse getting a clear run can capitalise, potentially suiting an outsider with hidden ability on handicap debut. Only happens if multiple pace scenarios fail.

races.paceDynamic: Marazion is the only confirmed front-runner and will set an uncontested lead alongside prominent runners Harana, Massarat and Al Rojo Vivo. With most of the field holding up or racing midfield, the early pace will be steady rather than fierce, allowing the leaders to dictate terms. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Carmel's Phoenix, Guy's Girl, Duvessa and Enchanted Lady will need to overcome a tactical disadvantage in a race lacking genuine pace pressure. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Marazion gets an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow for the hold-up horses to make up ground, allowing the early leaders to control the race completely. Prominent racers can track the leader and have first run when the pace quickens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Harana or Massarat apply early pressure to Marazion
scenarios.body: A genuine pace develops that brings the hold-up horses into play but still favours those with early speed. The best-rated closers can capitalize on a stronger gallop while the pace-setters may tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a slow pace followed by a sprint finish. Traffic will still be an issue but class can prevail in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all the early leaders go too slow and stop quickly
scenarios.body: A messy race where anything could happen as tired pace-setters are swamped by a wall of closers. The best horse on the day regardless of tactics could prevail.

watchPoints.text: Marazion could steal this with an uncontested lead if the prominent runners fail to apply pressure early
Traffic problems will be severe for hold-up horses like Carmel's Phoenix and Guy's Girl if pace is weak
Harana's stamina breeding could be key asset if she can stay prominent and outstay Marazion
Duvessa stepping up in trip for first time could find significant improvement for in-form O'Brien stable
Several horses carry fading tendencies which will be exposed if the pace becomes a sprint finish
